title: Rigid Band 159/165 Japanese Pokemon 151 Reverse Holo Poke Ball 2023 SV2a
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Pokemon 151 Reverse Holo Poke Ball 2023 SV2a is a must-have for any collector or fan of the franchise. The card features a stunning reverse holo finish and is made of high-quality card stock material. 

With a standard size and basic stage, this Pokemon card is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels. The card is from the Pokémon TCG and manufactured by Nintendo in Japan. It is part of the vintage Pokémon 151 set and comes in a Japanese language. The card is not autographed and is suitable for ages 4 and up.
